checkRuns.command:
bun run build 2>&1 | tail -5; export PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production; (bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 & echo $! >/tmp/pid); sleep 3
for p in / /books /books/dracula /books/nope /nope /contact; do echo "== $p"; curl -s -w '\n%{http_code}\n' localhost:4701$p | grep -v '<script\|<style' | head -c 1800; done
echo ==POST; curl -s -X POST -H "Origin: $ORIGIN" -d 'name=+&email=x&message=hi' localhost:4701/contact | grep -o '<main.*</main>'
curl -s -X POST -H "Origin: $ORIGIN" -d 'name=Bo&email=a@b.co&message=hello hello hello hello' -i localhost:4701/contact | head -20
bun run fmt >/dev/null 2>&1; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -2; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1; ss -ltn | grep 4701 || echo none; git status --short | head

failures: books > lists every book by title with its author and year
not found > /books/no-such-book answers 404 with the 404 page
not found > /no-such-page answers 404 with the 404 page
